snippet_primary: "I did the hard work and I take all of my own photos, make all of my own mockups, and all of my other designs. I also make all of my own products that I put my designs on, and I do it myself within my own business. Everyone should have to do the same on Etsy. It's about time that Etsy changed the rules to protect real artists."
